The Heavy helmet fix is written but not shipped. Every ship is blocked by a half-finished `cw-fewerguns` ship that left `dark_raiders.html` modified.

**The block.** That ship stopped on "container fingerprint moved" after it had already applied its edit. The working tree still holds VER 28.79 and the halved LOOT weights. `shipone.sh` refuses to start on a dirty game file, so `shipq.sh cw-helmbar` printed "uncommitted changes" on four tries. I can't revert the file (git is read-only for me, and neither `clearstale.sh` nor `fixq.sh` fits this). Someone with git write access has to restore `dark_raiders.html`. Lane b is currently running `b-11-lean8-fewer-guns`, and it will hit the same wall.

**The draft: `S\mk-cw-helmbar.ps1`, key `cw-helmbar`, step 1 of the brief.**
- **Change:** the tall accent-colour crest bar on the Heavy helmet becomes a low steel ridge. The scheme accent stays only as a small brow lens in an ink housing, with a white glint.
- **Check:** it draws the helmet on `schtoxic` to an offscreen canvas and measures pixels. The accent must be no taller than 4.5 px in any column, and at least 20 accent pixels must remain, so the lens is still there. I haven't run it against the old crest, so the fail-then-pass proof is still to come from the gate.
- **Lesson from another draft:** the old 28.16 check needs full-strength accent pixels on this helmet. A half-alpha stripe fails it, which is what stopped the other `cw-heavycrest` draft. My lens keeps full strength, so it should pass.

No `art.md` existed, so this run starts the notes. I wrote `notes\c-01-art.md` and `notes\art.md`. They record the blocker and the next steps: ink outline and hue ramps on the player body, pouches and bandolier, goggle glint, cast and gun shadow, Heavy and Raider plate details, then baking to sprites.

TASK PARTIAL: `cw-helmbar` is drafted but not shipped, because the dirty `dark_raiders.html` from the stopped `cw-fewerguns` ship must be cleaned first. After that, run `shipq.sh cw-helmbar`, then continue with the next step in `notes\art.md`.
